_comments: The base measures an AI quantity can be expressed in. Referenced by
AIModelPriceUnitType.UsageTypeID (what a billing unit is a quantity OF, and therefore what
every cost row priced by it measures) and by AIPromptRun.UsageTypeID (what a recorded
quantity counts). Distinct from MJ: AI Model Price Unit Types, which names the BILLING unit
and its scale: audio recorded in Seconds may be billed by the Per Hour unit type.
IDs are fixed rather than generated because AIModelPriceUnitType rows reference them by
@lookup on Name, and because a future migration that tightens UsageTypeID to NOT NULL will
need a stable Tokens row to default to.

fields.Name: Tokens
fields.Description: Discrete model tokens. The default measure for text models, and the measure every pre-existing cost row is recorded in.

fields.Name: Seconds
fields.Description: Seconds of continuous media — audio submitted for transcription, or audio synthesized. Always recorded in seconds regardless of the billing granularity; the price unit type converts to minutes or hours.

fields.Name: Characters
fields.Description: Characters of text submitted, used by text-to-speech models that bill per character rather than per token.

fields.Name: Images
fields.Description: Whole images generated or analyzed, for models that bill per image rather than by any continuous measure.
